test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If V & R @ F % H # T @ Q, then how is T related to R?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9f24b36a71f0f526ded66552fe8bb5ab25305beb45cb6172cde2faf4a322c7.png]

Hence,** 'option 1' **is the correct answer.
